programme.desc: S6 E10 — The Ipswich Way From the trailblazing success of Sir Alf Ramsey's league champions to Sir Bobby Robson's unforgettable FA Cup and UEFA Cup triumphs, this is the story of one of English football's most cherished clubs. We celebrate the remarkable highs, the resilience through changing times, and George Burley's extraordinary achievement in guiding Ipswich Town to a fifth-place finish in their first Premier League season.
programme.title: Premier League Stories

programme.desc: S6 E11 — The Tigers Return Hull City's return to the Premier League is the latest chapter in a story built on resilience, ambition and belief. We look back on the club's previous adventures in the top-flight, reliving the moments that shaped its identity before looking ahead to an exciting new era. Joining the Tigers at their pre-season training camp in Slovenia, we go behind the scenes to discover how the club is preparing for the challenges ahead.
programme.title: Premier League Stories

programme.desc: S6 E12 — Coventry Rising We follow Coventry City as they prepare for a long-awaited return to the Premier League, ending a 25-year absence from English football's top flight. With exclusive access during the club's pre-season training camp in Málaga, we go behind the scenes as players and staff build towards a landmark campaign filled with anticipation and expectation.
programme.title: Premier League Stories

programme.desc: S6 E14 — Petr Cech One of the Premier League's greatest-ever goalkeepers, Petr Čech's career was nearly changed forever by the horrific head injury he suffered in 2006. We sit down with him to discuss his remarkable recovery and journey back to the very top, before discovering how his competitive drive has continued, with the Czech shot-stopper swapping football for a new challenge playing Ice Hockey.
programme.title: Premier League Stories

programme.desc: S6 E15 — Amad Diallo From his early years in Ivory Coast to leaving Africa for Europe, Amad Diallo's journey has been one of talent, determination and sacrifice. After making his breakthrough in Italy, his potential earned him a dream move to Manchester United, where he has fought to establish himself on the Premier League stage. We follow Amad's remarkable rise and the journey that has taken him from humble beginnings to the heights of Old Trafford.
programme.title: Premier League Stories

programme.desc: S6 E16 — John Stones John Stones has experienced almost everything the game can offer; from the pressure of the biggest stage to the injuries and setbacks that have tested him along the way. After more than a decade at the heart of the Premier League, winning its biggest honours and helping redefine the role of a modern defender, he now takes his career in a new direction.
programme.title: Premier League Stories

programme.desc: S6 E17 — Granit Xhaka From his family's courageous journey in search of a better future to becoming one of Europe's most respected midfielders, this is the story of Granit Xhaka. We chart his rise through the game, the highs and lows of a career that tested his resilience, and the turbulent relationship with Arsenal supporters that ultimately became one of football's greatest redemption stories.
programme.title: Premier League Stories

programme.desc: S6 E18 — Roberto Mancini From a celebrated playing career in Italy to becoming the man who transformed Manchester City into Premier League champions, Roberto Mancini's footballing life has been filled with triumph, drama and unforgettable characters. PL Stories explores his fiery relationship with Mario Balotelli, 'that' extraordinary final-day victory over QPR, and the deep friendship he shared with the late Gianluca Vialli.
programme.title: Premier League Stories

programme.desc: S6 E20 — The Evolution of Goalkeepers Once the last line of defence, today's goalkeeper is expected to be so much more. From sweeper-keepers to playing out under pressure, we explore the innovations, characters and changing demands that have revolutionised one of football's most fascinating positions.
programme.title: Premier League Stories

programme.desc: S6 E21 — Marcus Stewart: The Fight of My Life Ipswich Town legend and former Sunderland striker Marcus Stewart built a career on taking on some of football's toughest challenges. Now, he faces a very different battle; one that has changed his life beyond the pitch and revealed a strength and determination far greater than anything football demanded of him.
programme.title: Premier League Stories

programme.desc: S6 E23 — Aston Villa 1992/93: Behind the First Season Aston Villa's 1992/93 season had all the ingredients of a defining football story. Through special behind-the-scenes footage, PL Stories takes viewers inside Ron Atkinson's Villa, revealing the characters, camaraderie and mounting pressure of a gripping title challenge. From the dressing room to the drama on the pitch, this is the inside story of Villa's pursuit of the first Premier League crown.
programme.title: Premier League Stories

programme.desc: S6 E24 — Mikel Arteta We explore Mikel Arteta's impact at Arsenal and the managerial approach behind his success, reflecting on how his upbringing and football education in the Basque region shaped his thinking. We examine his tactics, how he develops players and the standards he sets throughout the club. We look at the key decisions that have turned Arsenal into Premier League champions.
programme.title: Premier League Stories
